title: Gemini Markets: Bitcoin ETFs Stage Rally
summary: A trio of US spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in more than $1 billion over a three-day stretch this week.
body_markdown:
*Welcome to Gemini Markets, your weekly read on crypto, stocks and equities, and prediction markets, all in one super app. This is the newsletter that will help inform you about what’s driving crypto and stock prices, tradfi market trends, and prediction market trends.*


### 📈 Crypto Markets Overview


**BlackRock’s crypto ETF posts best day in 12 months:** The demand for BlackRock’s landmark bitcoin ETF continued to grow this week. And now the asset management giant is planning to double down.[IShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded approximately $665 million in net inflows on Monday, marking the largest single-day inflows since October 2025.](https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-20-blackrock-ibit-bitcoin-etf-665-million-421102)[BlackRock also filed an application this week to launch iShares Protect Bitcoin Managed Protect ETF,](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/bitcoin-etf-news-blackrock-wants-123143491.html) an exchange-traded fund that offers investors downside protection against bitcoin price swings while also capping potential gains.[Institutional demand for crypto ETFs has remained strong this week, with three funds posting more than $1 billion in inflows.](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/22/bitcoin-etfs-attract-usd1-08-billion-in-3-days-but-it-may-not-be-enough-for-a-steep-rally)


**Zcash eyes upgrade on November 5:**[Zcash developers have set their sights on November 5 for the NU7 mainnet upgrade.](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/21/zcash-developers-confirm-november-date-for-upgrade-that-triples-payment-speed) The upgrade will reportedly trim block times from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. It would also allocate 60% of transaction fees for future block rewards. The upgrade will also eliminate the network’s legacy Sprout v4 transaction format. Zcash has mounted a renewed rally the past five days ahead of the upgrade, jumping almost 10% after it pulled back toward $1,100 earlier this month. The privacy-focused cryptocurrency has rallied more than 400% over the past 12 months, helping push its market cap to almost $21 billion.


**Crypto continues trading in tight range:** The crypto market has had a sluggish October. Bitcoin and other top cryptocurrencies mounted a modest rally mid-week before reversing course Thursday amid a wider tech sell-off. October has historically served as a month for bitcoin and other top cryptocurrencies to rally, but the lack of major bull narratives this year has kept digital assets from making its typical push amid a tougher macroeconomic backdrop. As of mid-day Thursday, the price of bitcoin was trading around $81,400.

### 📊 Stocks & Equities


**SpaceX beats earnings expectations, Musk floats merger with Tesla:**[Shares of SpaceX jumped more than 10% on Wednesday after the company reported $14.6 billion revenue in Q3 on Tuesday, a 161% increase from the same period a year earlier.](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/spacex-spcx-stock-musk-merger-tesla.html) The company posted net income of $4.4 billion after it lost more than $1 billion during the same period a year earlier. Founder Elon Musk said on the earnings call he was considering a merger with Tesla, noting there’s “a lot to be gained from cooperating.”


**Tech stocks sell off as AI continues pullback:**[The Nasdaq index dropped about 2% by mid-day Thursday, with AI stocks continuing a sell-off after a brief respite earlier this week from AI spending concerns.](https://www.wsj.com/finance/investing/ai-stocks-slide-after-earnings-disappoint-french-bonds-tumble-and-oil-tops-112-734e47a7) The latest dump came amid some investor concern about renewed tension in the Middle East, pushing oil prices higher. Investors have also expressed concern about the sustainability of ambitious corporate AI spending plans in a restrictive rate environment.

And the World Series this year will take on added meaning for two teams that have never won a championship. The Milwaukee Brewers are currently the popular pick to break their long drought, with Gemini Predictions traders giving the National League champs a 68% chance to knock off the Tampa Bay Rays in the World Series.[Trade the pro baseball champion here.](https://www.gemini.com/predictions/BASEBALL26/pro-baseball-champion?categoryPath=sports%2Csports_pro-baseball&status=active)


**Oklahoma City Thunder enter the NBA season as trading favorites:** The NBA season tipped off Tuesday with a slate of games featuring the league’s top franchises. The Thunder took down the San Antonio Spurs 116-104 in a testy battle that could serve as a preview of the Western Conference Finals. Traders currently give the Thunder a leading 27% chance to capture the NBA title, followed by the Spurs at 23%.[Trade the pro basketball champion here.](https://www.gemini.com/predictions/NBAF-2627CHAMP/2027-pro-basketball-champion?categoryPath=sports%2Csports_basketball&status=active)


**Democrats favored to take back Congress:** With the midterms a few weeks away, traders have become almost certain that the Democrats will regain control of the US House of Representatives and are also favoring them to win the US Senate.
